question.text: A PMS client wants MONTHLY rebalancing but the PM prefers QUARTERLY. Resolution:

answer.text: Document preference in IPS and communicate cost trade-off; agreement required

explanation.text: The Logic: The IPS should define the rebalancing policy, which requires a cost-benefit trade-off; the PMS agreement separately defines the rights and obligations of the parties. The Trap: Unilateral overrides break the client relationship; rebalancing frequency is a documented policy choice, not a unilateral PM decision. Note: Source: NISM-Series-XXI-B Portfolio Managers workbook, p.395-396, p.150.
